cards.card_text: Esther is taken to King Xerxes in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
cards.verse_text: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal palace in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
cards.snippet: …Xerxes in the royal palace in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
